Prototype 5 encodes N2 (100% pure) primarily through EEG (60%), with EOG (34%) and EMG (6%) contribution.
Its EEG signature shows suppressed β_h (-0.7 dB, sensitivity=2.9) and elevated δ (+2.9 dB, sensitivity=2.8).
The β_h activity is present in 0% of each epoch (transient), with quiescent eye movements (SEM 21% active) and intermediate muscle tone.
This is partially coherent with N2 physiology: confirmed: σ elevated, EOG quiescent; missing: σ relevant. Note: model primarily uses β_h, atypical for N2.
